source_text: Ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τῶν ἀνόμων ὑπερμάχων τῆς εἰδωλολατρίας προστάγματα ἀσεβῆ κατὰ τῶν εὐσεβούντων Χριστιανῶν κατὰ πόλιν καὶ χώραν ἐξετίθετο, ὥστε αὐτοὺς ἀναγκάζεσθαι σπένδειν τοῖς ματαίοις εἰδώλοις. Συλληφθέντες οὖν οἱ ἅγιοι ἄνδρες εἰσήχθησαν πρὸς τὸν τῆς Ῥώμης ἔπαρχον ὀνόματι Ῥουστικόν.
pass_a_gloss: In the time of the lawless ultra-fighters for idol-worship, impious edicts against the god-revering Christians throughout city and countryside were being set out in public, so that they were being compelled to pour offerings to the empty idols. Therefore, after being seized, the holy men were led in before the eparch of Rome, by name Rusticus.
pass_b_english: In the days of the lawless champions of idolatry, impious decrees were published against the devout Christians in every city and countryside, to force them to pour libations to vain idols. The holy men were then arrested and brought before Rusticus, the prefect of Rome.

choices.why: ὑπέρμαχος is a militant agent noun and the genitive τῆς εἰδωλολατρίας gives the cause fought for; martial rendering fits a persecution context
imperfect passive with public force; singular verb with neuter plural subject προστάγματα is normal agreement, and context is empire-wide posting of decrees
